verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly claim plugin-based hardware support for Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi, IBM Spyre, Huawei Ascend, and other accelerators beyond NVIDIA/AMD GPUs, directly matching the story. However, this is only first-party documentation with no independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically validating TPU or Gaudi plugin usage, and no detail on setup complexity or maturity of these plugins. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of TPU/Gaudi plugin functionality, details on plugin API stability or limitations, and hands-on reports of successful runs on these accelerators.
